segments.baseText:
Beneath the white, the roads continue.
Beneath the roads, the footsteps remain.
Warmth traveled from door to door.
Names slept beneath the dead lights.
The world was not lost.
It was carried below.

Houses leaned into the dark.
Bridges kept the shape of rivers.
Windows held the last blue of evening.
A thousand rooms forgot the sun.
Still, in every wall,
a life pressed outward.

Many voices entered one silence.
Many hands entered one keeping.
A child’s name. A worker’s song.
Rain striking metal.
A face beside the fire.
Nothing was permitted to end.

The surface was wounded.
Cold entered through the wound.
What was taken above
was gathered below.
The sky became distance.
The world became memory.

The keeper stood over the roads.
The keeper made a passage,
then closed it.
Not a tomb.
Not sleep.
A place for everything lost
to remain.
When the lid fell,
the dark did not speak.
It opened its buried doors.
Beneath the world,
the world was kept.
